objective: Converge hosted sandbox, notebook, API GPU, and local render-capable workers behind one ComputePool and ComputeRouter while preserving deterministic admission and F07 physical truth.

rulesConsidered: Only real artifact-producing workers may enter render routing.
Deterministic capability, health, policy, lease, and fencing boundaries remain authoritative.
GLiDE/Ascalon is advisory until calibration and promotion evidence exists.
Physical artifact truth remains owned by F06/F07 verification and CAS.

security.notes: Provider credentials remain environment/connection scoped. Hosted sandbox credentials are not sent into GLiDE state or routing telemetry.

changes: Replaced PandaStack sandbox contracts and registration with hosted Daytona and Modal adapters.
Added canonical ShortForgeRenderWorker contract and ComputePool registry.
Wrapped Kaggle hosted notebook execution as a physical-artifact-producing render worker.
Wrapped hosted Daytona/Modal sandboxes as render workers only when a real render command/output contract is configured.
Bound ComputeRouter to ComputePool hard preflight.
Added explicit worker preflight state to the Ascalon/GLiDE decision packet.
Added pool, capacity, timeout, and F06 physical-artifact failover tests.
notes: RunPod/Vast control-plane adapters are intentionally not registered as render workers because their current provider classes do not execute and return physical artifacts truthfully.
Legacy provider classes remain discoverable for compatibility but are excluded from the unified ComputePool.
GLiDE selection remains advisory and cannot bypass hard worker admission.
